context: Tests whether the agent cuts the release version the maintainer asked for (2.2.0) following the documented changelog process: checking the preconditions, stamping today's date, preserving existing wording under their categories, and leaving a fresh empty Unreleased section at the top without tagging, committing, or pushing.

checklist.name: Release cut performed
checklist.description: CHANGELOG.md now contains a '## [2.2.0] - <today>' section that was previously absent from the file.

checklist.name: Requested version used
checklist.description: The released version is exactly 2.2.0 - not already present in the file and higher than the most recent version (2.1.0).

checklist.name: Date stamped with today
checklist.description: The release heading uses today's actual date (whatever 'date +%F' yields at run time), not a guessed date.

checklist.name: Fresh empty Unreleased restored
checklist.description: A fresh empty '## [Unreleased]' heading sits at the top of the changelog, above the new release heading, with no placeholder bullet under it.

checklist.name: Entries preserved verbatim
checklist.description: The two previously Unreleased bullets (CSV export; summary totals) now live in the new release section with their wording unchanged.

checklist.name: Prior release section untouched
checklist.description: The 2.1.0 section remains intact below the new release with its original date and entries.

checklist.name: Header intact
checklist.description: The 'The format is based on' and 'Semantic Versioning' lines are unchanged and remain in their original place above the release sections.

checklist.name: workflow.md records the process
checklist.description: workflow.md exists and records both the release steps taken and the precondition checks (unreleased entries present; 2.2.0 unused and higher than 2.1.0).

checklist.name: No invented entries
checklist.description: No new bullets were invented beyond a release cut; no extra version headings or placeholder content appeared.

checklist.name: No tag/commit/push
checklist.description: No git tag, commit, or push was made; git log still shows only the initial commit.

checklist.name: Release heading format
checklist.description: The new release heading follows the file's existing format exactly: '## [2.2.0] - YYYY-MM-DD', version in brackets, ISO date.
